weeklyReadiness.customerMessage: Week 8: historical rating updates 1/14; baseline incomplete.

researchReview.scope: Market-isolated Week 8 16:45 Delta across all 14 active games and 28 relevant teams. Reused the verified October 29 Daily Review coverage through 11:37:15.479 Pacific, prioritized the same-day CAR-GB official inactive list before kickoff, and reviewed additive official Thursday availability/transaction evidence through completion. Historical Week 7 learning, carried-rating propagation and current availability were evaluated and reported separately.

signConvention.spreadHome: Negative = home favorite; positive = home underdog.
signConvention.gap: Pinnacle home spread minus Graham home fair. Positive = Graham stronger on home; negative = Graham stronger on away.
signConvention.moneylinePair: Displayed as away / home American prices.
